tourCurrentBody: Codex’s connected account appears here automatically.
tourAddBody: This button opens browser sign-in. Your current account stays connected.
tourSwitchBody: Save your work first. Codex will close and reopen with this account.
tourRemoveBody: Only the saved account is removed. Your chats and Codex sign-in stay as they are.
subtitle: Pick an account. Get going.
emptyBody: Add an account to get started. We’ll take care of the rest.
switchBody: Codex will close and reopen. Save any work in progress first.
removeBody: This removes the saved account from this app. Your chats and current Codex sign-in stay as they are.
browserBody: Continue in your browser. Your current Codex account stays connected.
recoveryBody: The last switch was interrupted. Restore your previous connection to continue.
error: That didn’t work. Please try again.
networkError: Can’t connect right now. Check your internet connection and try again.
loginError: Please sign in to this account again.
wrongAccount: That is a different account. Choose the account you’re reconnecting.
cliError: Open the installed Codex app once, then try adding your account again.
loginSaved: Account added. You’re ready to switch!
loginFailed: Sign-in didn’t finish. Try Add account again.
loginTimeout: Sign-in timed out. Try Add account again.
syncError: Couldn’t update your accounts. Retrying automatically.
appOnly: Open ChatGPT Account Switcher to use your accounts.
